records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, North Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *North Ventures* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly said they're still deciding and asked for another week [email:7bc444be], after two unanswered nudges [email:356e8d32, email:b30066e8]. No project, no invite, no milestone at day 6; 8 days left. Evaluation stance plus zero product activity makes unaided activation unlikely, though Pro plan and 8 days leave some chance.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for being straight with me — totally fair to take another week to decide whether Wrenfield fits your team, and I won't crowd you in the meantime.

One thing that might make the evaluation easier: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so seeing one real project in Wrenfield usually tells you more than a demo would. If it's useful, I'm happy to help you set up that first project whenever you're ready — just reply and I'll take it from there.

Best,
Chidi
